# Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin02a1)
**ID:** Atk Vin02a1
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Vinayapiṭake (Dutiyo bhāgo) (atk-vin02)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā* constitutes the commentary on the Pācittiya section of the Vinayapiṭaka, designated in the catalog as the second volume (*Dutiyo bhāgo*) of the Vinaya commentary collection (*Aṭṭhakathā Vinayapiṭake*).
In modern scholarship, the text is noted as one of the post-canonical Pāli works preserving references to King Ajātasattu outside of the standard patricide narrative [Radich 2011].
Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive reuse between the *Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā* and 264 other Pāli texts, registering 33,067 shared passages [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual overlaps occur with Vinaya subcommentaries (*ṭīkā*), manuals, and related commentary volumes, most notably the *Vinayapiṭake Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi* (5,089 matches), the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā* (4,679 matches), the *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā* (2,315 matches), the *Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā* (across all three volumes), the *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā* (1,535 matches), and the *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* (1,409 matches), as well as canonical Vinaya material such as the *Bhikkhunikkhandhaka* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with a score of 10 or greater are detected [DharmaNexus].
**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Vinayapiṭake Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi (Tika Vin04t) (§229_9–240 ↔ §1266_13–1268_22); Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin01a) (§681_0–681_3 ↔ §931_0–931_4); Vinayapiṭake Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā (Tika Vin05t) (§369_5–386_11 ↔ §390_8–408_0); Vinayapiṭake Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā (Tika Vin11t) (§1442_0–1444 ↔ §3133_0–3135); Vinayapiṭake Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā (Tika Vin09t) (§976_5–983_6 ↔ §2098_1–2104_6); Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā (tatiyo bhāgo) (Tika Vin02t) (§350_3–350_6 ↔ §253_1–253_5); Vinayapiṭake Vinayālaṅkāra-ṭīkā (Tika Vin08t) (§1094_0–1095_7 ↔ §2118_1–2119_7); Vinayapiṭake Khuddasikkhā-mūlasikkhā (Tika Vin13t) (§1393_0–1395_5 ↔ §2233_1–2236_4)
